posts.post: Everyone expects me to take that corporate job after graduation. I spent all night working on the STRAYED patterns instead. It feels right to choose the uncertainty over the paycheck.
I need some eyes on these designs. If you had to pick one aesthetic that screams leaving the path behind, what would it be. Let me know what you think.
Building this from my room in India with a global mindset. It is not always pretty and the stress is real, but I would not trade the freedom for anything else.
We are keeping it simple for the May launch. No noise, just solid gear that actually lasts. What is one thing you hate about the clothes you buy right now.
